senses.gloss:
n. (-त्यं)
1 Whiteness.
2 Vitiligo.
E.
श्वित or श्वेत, and ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-त्रं)
Vitiligo.
E.
श्वेत to be white, रन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Self-willed, unrestrained.
2 Slow, lazy.
n. (-रं)
Following one's own inclination.
E.
स्व self, ईर to go or be, aff. अण्.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Acting or living as one likes.
E.
स्वैर, and वृत्त practising.

f. (-ता)
Wilfulness, independence.
E.
स्वैर self-willed, तल् aff.

f. (-ता)
Wilfulness.
E.
स्वैरिन् self-willed, तल् aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Uncontrouled, self-willed.
f. (-णी)
1 An unchaste wife, an adulteress^1.
2 A wanton woman.
E.
स्व self, ईर to go, णिनि aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.
